driver: SOAK_CONTAINER_LOG_BUDGET_MB (default 400) and SOAK_NODE_LOG_BUDGET_MB (default 2560) are parsed and range-checked like the disk floor. A value of 0 disables a probe.

For each owned node container the guardian samples the container json-file log (docker inspect LogPath, stat, sudo -n stat fallback) and the node log directory (docker exec du, a missing directory counts as 0) under a deadline.
Three consecutive samples over a budget, or one sample at two times a budget, is a breach that writes the guardian record, stops the owned writers, and stamps the health tag.
An unreadable probe refuses iteration and benchmark admission and is a breach during work. The guardian also starts when only a log budget is set.
